slides.title: Welcome
slides.heading: Grow food where you live
slides.sub: A balcony, a stoep or a small yard is enough
slides.narration: You do not need a farm. This course shows you how to grow vegetables in the space you already have.

slides.title: The idea
slides.text: You do not need a farm to grow good food. You need sun, good soil and a plan.

slides.title: Who it is for
slides.heading: This course is for you if
points: You rent a flat or a small house
Your pots of vegetables keep failing
You are starting a school or community garden

slides.title: How a module works
slides.heading: Every module, step by step
steps: A short presentation sets the scene
Flash cards fix it in memory
A task you do in your own space

slides.title: Work it out
slides.label: of potting soil fills a tub big enough for one tomato plant. You learn to work out your own.

slides.title: Try a question
slides.question: What pH do most vegetables prefer?
slides.explanation: Between about 6.0 and 7.0 the nutrients in the soil are within the roots' reach. The course shows you how to test your own.

slides.title: Start growing
slides.heading: Fill your first container this season
slides.text: Every module ends with something you do in your own space.
